snippet.title: Sports Card Shop Simulator - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Rip open packs and flip cards for profit while building the sports card shop of your dreams. Hunt for holos, parallels,autos, and numbered cards to satisfy your collection obsession. Design your own card and experience the ultimate high as you pull yourself out of a pack!

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4157170/Sports_Card_Shop_Simulator/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
